message:
test(dlss): add native NGX execution through production Renderer

Add --native to the asset-free renderer fixture with actual Controller,
recommended sizes, feature reuse/reconfiguration, alpha/readback checks,
and isolated evaluation failure. Register a distinct CTest label with
unsupported/SDK-disabled skip=77; API/dispatch errors remain failures.
Also drain local image owners safely on assertion exceptions.
Real NVIDIA execution and gameplay remain unverified in hosted CI.
